title: Athinization of irreducible $\widehat{\mathfrak{gl}}_n$-modules with dominant highest weights
summary: We study the Gelfand-Tsetlin realization of generic Verma modules for the affine Lie algebra $\widehat{\mathfrak{gl}}_n$ by viewing them as thin modules over the affine Yangian $Y(\widehat{\mathfrak{sl}}_n)$. By results of arXiv:0812.4656, these modules admit a basis indexed by periodic Gelfand-Tsetlin patterns with explicit formulas for the Yangian action, and we identify them with the evaluation modules introduced by Kodera arXiv:1806.09884.
